summary.content:
Today's selection covers 75 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 48 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Dave Eggers told OpenAI staff  that ChatGPT was ‘silencing an entire generation’
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: In Other News: Iran Tracks US Military Phones, CrashStealer macOS Malware, CVD Blueprint
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 10 articles published in the last 24 hours
